q: "Do I look like a weirdo?" “Well, yuh-uh.” Ok, it was a stupid question.
“We got you!” Fung said as they backed the duckling named Zan against a wall. “Nuh-uh!” Zan said. “Yuh-uh!” Fung argued when— “NUH-UH!” Tigress called.
'He's into you,' sang Kat in his ear. 'Nu-uh.' 'Yuh-uh.' 'Naw, dude, he's my accountant?'
